meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'иженный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('offended, hurt').

examples.trans: I am still upset with you.

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to remain, to be left', paired with 'оставаться'.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: Простите! = sorry! forgive me!. Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'стить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forgive; (imperative) excuse me', paired with 'прощать'.

В прошлый раз = last time. Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'шлый'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('last, past, previous').

examples.text: В прошлый раз я думала, война началась.
